explication: Arc Pinned Tabs to HTML Bookmarks Converter is a command-line script that reads Arc sidebar JSON and produces browser-importable HTML bookmarks. The main workflow is CLI entry point → JSON input → pinned-space and bookmark conversion → HTML serialization → output file. The source excerpt shows the internal calls; the README documents the CLI options and input locations.
